entities.summary: Nandu Gyawali, known as Nandar, is a feminist activist in Myanmar. She is the founder of the Purple Feminists Group and hosts the podcasts G-Taw Zagar Wyne and Feminist Talks. In 2020, she was named to the BBC's 100 Women list. Nandar was a poets & playwrights from Namtu Township (b. 1995, Namtu Township).
